rows.question: From which date must taxpayers with annual turnover of more than RM25 million and up to RM100 million issue e-Invoices?
top_docs: LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p12
LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p13
LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p14
rows.answer: Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of more than RM25 million and up to RM100 million are required to implement and issue e-Invoices starting from 1 January 2025 [1].

rows.question: How many hours does a buyer have to request rejection of a validated e-Invoice that contains errors?
top_docs: LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p24
LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p34
LHDN e-Invoice Guideline p32
rows.answer: A buyer has 72 hours from the time of validation to request the rejection of an e-Invoice that contains errors [1][3].

rows.question: What is the threshold value for mandatory service tax registration for rental or leasing services?
rows.expected_source: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Rental or Leasing Services
top_docs: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Rental or Leasing Services p22
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Rental or Leasing Services p7
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Rental or Leasing Services p19
rows.answer: The threshold value for mandatory service tax registration for rental or leasing services is RM500,000 within a period of 12 months [1][2][3].

rows.question: What is the maximum fine for a registered person who furnishes an incorrect Service Tax return?
rows.expected_source: RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment
top_docs: RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p8
RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p9
RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p4
rows.answer: A registered person who furnishes an incorrect Service Tax return is guilty of an offense under subsection 26(6) of the Service Tax Act 2018 and can be fined up to a maximum of RM50,000.00, face up to 3 years imprisonment, or both [1][2].

rows.question: By when must a taxable person furnish the SST-02 return?
rows.expected_source: RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment
top_docs: RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p6
RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p12
RMCD Sales Tax & Service Tax Guide on Return and Payment p4
rows.answer: A taxable person must furnish the Form SST-02 return to the Director General no later than the last day of the month following the end of their taxable period [1][3][5]. Additional timing rules include: - If the taxable period does not end on the last day of the month, the return must be furnished no later than the last day of the thirty-day period from the end of the varied taxable period [1]. - If the last day falls on a Federal weekly holiday or Federal public holiday, the return must be received on the day immediately after the holiday [1].

rows.question: What is the service tax rate on management services and when did it take effect?
rows.expected_source: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Management Services
top_docs: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Management Services p4
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Management Services p5
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Management Services p7
rows.answer: The service tax rate on management services is 8%, effective from 1 March 2024 [1][2]. Management services were previously subject to service tax at a rate of 6% starting from 1 September 2018 [1].

rows.question: How many days must an individual be physically present in Malaysia in a basis year to be a tax resident under the 182-day rule?
rows.expected_source: LHDN Public Ruling 11/2017 (Residence Status of Individuals)
top_docs: LHDN Public Ruling 11/2017 (Residence Status of Individuals) p6
LHDN Public Ruling 11/2017 (Residence Status of Individuals) p8
LHDN Public Ruling 11/2017 (Residence Status of Individuals) p17
rows.answer: Under the 182-day rule (Paragraph 7(1)(a) of the ITA), an individual must be present in Malaysia in the basis year for a Year of Assessment (YA) for a period or periods amounting in all to 182 days or more to qualify as a tax resident [1]. The period of stay does not have to be consecutive days [1].

rows.question: What is the deduction limit for a gift of money made by an individual to an approved institution, organization or fund?
rows.expected_source: LHDN Public Ruling 7/2025 (Resident Individual: Gifts or Contributions and Allowable Deductions)
top_docs: LHDN Public Ruling 7/2025 (Resident Individual: Gifts or Contributions and Allowable Deductions) p6
LHDN Public Ruling 7/2025 (Resident Individual: Gifts or Contributions and Allowable Deductions) p5
LHDN Public Ruling 7/2025 (Resident Individual: Gifts or Contributions and Allowable Deductions) p57
rows.answer: The deduction for a gift of money made to an approved institution, organization, or fund is restricted to 10% of the individual's aggregate income.

rows.question: Which professional services are listed under Group G of the First Schedule of the Service Tax Regulations 2018?
rows.expected_source: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Professional Services
top_docs: RMCD Service Tax Guide on Professional Services p4
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Professional Services p20
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Professional Services p32
rows.answer: The professional services listed under Group G, First Schedule of the Service Tax Regulations 2018 are [1]: (i) Legal services, (ii) Legal services on Islamic matters, (iii) Accounting services, (iv) Surveying services, (v) Engineering services, (vi) Architectural services, (vii) Consultancy, training and coaching services, (viii) Information technology services, (ix) Management services, (x) Employment services, (xi) Safety or security services, and (xii) Digital services.

rows.question: Which currency exchange rate should a supplier use in an e-Invoice for a foreign currency transaction when no legal or tax requirement applies?
top_docs: LHDN e-Invoice Specific Guideline p102
LHDN e-Invoice Specific Guideline p17
RMCD Service Tax Guide on Rental or Leasing Services p16
rows.answer: Where no legal or tax requirement on the currency exchange rate is applicable, the supplier may follow the currency exchange rate per their internal policy [1][4].
